color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Step 1: Collect failures
All outputs below eval threshold
Target: 50-200 cases
Stratify by theme, date, source

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Step 2: Read the data
Manually read 20-50 cases
Before ANY automation
Form hypotheses about root causes
'Do not trust your dashboard'

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Step 3: Cluster by root cause
Group by WHY, not by symptom
Common root causes:
- Prompt ambiguity
- Taxonomy gap
- Multi-label blind spot
- Retrieval failure
- Training data gap

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Step 4: Prioritise
Score = Frequency × Severity × Fixability
Fix highest-impact cluster first
NOT the easiest one

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Step 5: Hypothesise and test fix
Propose targeted fix
Test on failing cluster ONLY
Verify no regression on others

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Deploy fix
Add cases to gold set
Document root cause
Monitor for recurrence

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Monitor production
1-2% sampling
Alert on drift
